name: Electromagnetic Fields and Waves
description: Review of Maxwell’s equations, wave propagations in unbounded medium. Boundary conditions, polarization, reflection and refraction of plane waves. Waveguides: parallel-plate guide, TE, TM and TEM waves, rectangular and cylindrical waveguides, resonators. Dielectric guides and optical fibres. Transmission Lines: distributed parameter circuits, traveling and standing waves, impedance matching, Smith chart, analogy with plane waves. Planar transmission lines: stripline, micro stripline. Radiation: retarded potentials, Hertzian dipole, short loop, antenna parameters.
